default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1038.title: Volume-climax bar at a fresh extreme fade
E-1038.hypothesis: A bar with several times the usual volume that pokes to a new range extreme and closes at its end is late aggressive flow exhausting itself; the other side absorbs it and price snaps back.

E-1039.title: Narrowest-bar break
E-1039.hypothesis: A bar with the smallest range of the last n bars shows a pause in order flow; the first close beyond its high/low is where waiting orders resolve.

E-1040.title: Dollar-lead catch-up
E-1040.hypothesis: The index and the dollar move inversely; when the dollar moves sharply and the index has not yet responded, arbitrage and macro flow pull the index the other way.

E-1041.title: Round-number rejection
E-1041.hypothesis: Round index levels hold clustered resting orders; a bar that touches the next round number and closes back under it (or the one below and closes over) is fading into that liquidity.

E-1042.title: Volume-ramp run follow
E-1042.hypothesis: Consecutive closes in one direction, each on more volume than the last and above the usual size, mean participation is growing with the move; follow it.

E-1043.title: Bollinger band re-entry fade
E-1043.hypothesis: A close outside a k-sigma band followed by a close back inside signals an overextension that has lost its push; trade back toward the mean.

E-1044.title: Squeeze release follow
E-1044.hypothesis: After volatility falls well below its usual level for the hour, the first bar that is large relative to that quiet marks stops and new orders being hit together; follow it.

E-1045.title: Low-participation new extreme fade
E-1045.hypothesis: A new session high or low printed on well below normal volume and closed against its direction lacks real buyers or sellers behind it; fade it.

E-1046.title: Late-day trend carry
E-1046.hypothesis: In the last hours, institutions and day traders reduce risk in the direction of the day's drift; a reclaim of a short EMA on the day's side is a continuation entry.

E-1047.title: Session-range midpoint hold
E-1047.hypothesis: Once the day's range is built, holding on one side of its midpoint for a while shows that side controls the balance; follow the first confirmation.
